title: Galactic
tagline: A first-of-its-kind Solana SPL-token trading bot for Discord, enabling seamless in-app token trading, portfolio tracking, and price alerts. Bringing Solana trading to 220M+ Discord users, unlocking a massive new market for on-chain activity.
description:
Currently, Solana SPL-token trading bots dominate Telegram, processing millions in daily transactions, but Discord—home to 220M+ active users and a major hub for crypto communities—lacks a similar tool. This project introduces the first dedicated SPL-token trading bot for Discord, providing a seamless trading experience directly within the platform.

The bot will allow users to:

Trade SPL tokens in real time without leaving Discord
Check wallet balances and manage orders via simple Discord commands
Set price alerts and track portfolio holdings within Discord
Ensure security with robust transaction verification and monitoring
By integrating Solana’s trading ecosystem into Discord, this bot will expand the reach of on-chain transactions, making token trading more accessible to a vast new audience.

Key Goals & Milestones
Deploy a Fully Functional SPL-Token Trading Bot on Discord
Ensure Security & Reliability with automated monitoring and anti-fraud measures
Onboard 50+ Discord communities for closed beta testing
Drive Adoption & Usage with a target of 5,000 active users within three months
Increase Transaction Volume, targeting $500,000 in trading volume in the first quarter
This bot is a game-changer for Solana’s ecosystem, driving more transactions, increasing engagement, and bridging the gap between crypto communities on Telegram and Discord. 🚀
how_its_made:
The bot is built using several npm pacakages like discord.js for interacting with discord APIs, solana web3.js lib for interacting with solana blockchain. We used mongoDB as the database and prisma as the ORM. 

For Embeeded wallets we use privy server wallets feature which is really great
